subject: RSW_Clodhopper
departures: four limbs and no wings at all; it stands on four legs, not upright on two like a bird
large, powerful clawed forelegs, bigger and heavier than any bird's limbs
tough, bare brown skin over the whole body, with no feathers or plumage
crimson skin on the neck, not a wattle or feathered ruff
a pale beak on a head carried low and forward on a four-legged body
